thread:
leila: ACME support case - Private VPC in us-west-2 reporting increased p99 and observations that responses show EU region headers. Customer attached curl output and flow logs.

sam: can you drop the raw curl -v they ran + pod source IP?

leila: here
re the headers they captured from their pod run: 

curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \\n  --data '{\"model\":\"redwood-1.0\",\"input\":\"test\"}'

< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
< X-Request-ID: req_9a8b7c6d
< Via: corp-proxy:3128
< X-Forwarded-Region: eu-west-1

They also uploaded VPC flow log lines showing SNAT to 34.205.99.11 and TCP connect to 34.205.99.11:3128 (their corporate proxy). Pod source IP is 10.1.12.45.

ivan: initial read: our routing accepts X-Forwarded-Region for some legacy/private accounts. If an on-prem proxy injects that header we can be forced to a remote region.

sam: ask them to run these from a failing pod: 
1) traceroute -n -T api.redwood-inference.internal
2) curl -sv -H 'Host: api.redwood-inference.internal' https://api.redwood-inference.internal/health

leila: they ran them. Traceroute shows next-hop 10.1.12.1 -> corp-nat -> 34.205.99.11 (proxy). Curl shows a CONNECT to proxy, then the proxy forwards; response contains Via and X-Forwarded-Region: eu-west-1. No preserved client IP in the forwarded request.

maya: that X-Forwarded-Region is the smoking gun. For compatibility we currently have logic that honors that header for some private accounts. The proxy is effectively asserting EU.

ivan: I pulled the control-plane routing logs for req_9a8b7c6d: decision: header_present=true header_value=eu-west-1 client_ip=10.1.12.45 -> selected europe-variant. Repro is clear.

leila: customer says they cannot change corporate proxy behavior enterprise-wide. They need a fix from us.

sam: short-term mitigation: we can flip a per-account flag to ignore X-Forwarded-Region for this org so routing will use geo from source IP. We need eng-platform + eng-networking approval to apply.

maya: longer term we should: 
- document proxy configuration snippets to preserve client IP (proxy_protocol / X-Forwarded-For) and avoid injecting region-specific headers
- change router fallback to prefer source IP geolocation when source IP maps to the customer's VPC CIDR
- add a per-account toggle in the control plane to disable honoring region headers

ops-bot: Deploy ticket created: routing-ignore-region-header-acme (deploy id dbg-2025-08-02-11) :white_check_mark:

ivan: I'll add a safety that the ignore-header toggle only applies to private deployments and only when client IP maps to declared VPC ranges to avoid breaking customers purposely using region headers.

leila: CASE-2025-2711 opened. We applied the ignore-header flag as a temporary workaround for ACME. Customer reports immediate latency improvement: p99 went from ~1.6s to ~110ms.

support-bot: CASE-2025-2711 status=workaround_applied note=\"ignore X-Forwarded-Region for account; platform patch in progress\"

sam: action items: 
- eng-networking: share proxy config guide with customer (preserve client IP, remove X-Forwarded-Region)
- eng-platform (maya): implement per-account toggle + VPC CIDR guard (P1)
- support: keep monitoring ACME p99 for 24h and confirm no regression

maya: I'll own the platform change and the canary. Ivan, please add telemetry to flag any accounts that rely on header-based routing so we can watch for accidental impact.

ivan: adding metrics and small canary slice. Also adding a lint rule in router to warn if header and source-IP disagree for private accounts.

leila: customer will leave the case open for 24h monitoring. We'll add a troubleshooting note in the private deployment playbook: check proxies for injected region headers and for SNAT behavior that prevents client-ip preservation.

sam: short postmortem blurb: \"on-prem/corporate proxy injecting X-Forwarded-Region caused routing stickiness to EU. Temporary per-account ignore applied; platform change to follow.\"

maya: agreed. I'll schedule a follow-up doc and include example proxy snippets: nginx stream with proxy_protocol, haproxy forwarding, and Squid config to avoid adding X-Forwarded-Region.

leila: thanks team. Closing loop after 24h stability check. :thumbsup:
